model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of completions and coverage for different language models. The x-axis is labeled "Number of completions (k)" and ranges from 2<sup>0</sup> to 2<sup>8</sup>, displayed on a logarithmic scale with tick labels at each power of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Coverage" and ranges from 0.38 to 0.92, displayed on a linear scale with tick labels at 0.2 intervals. A blue line with circular markers represents "Llama-3B", starting at approximately 0.41 when the number of completions is 2<sup>0</sup> and rising to approximately 0.91 when the number of completions is 2<sup>8</sup>. A green line with triangular markers represents "Llama-3B + FT", starting at approximately 0.43 when the number of completions is 2<sup>0</sup> and rising to approximately 0.92 when the number of completions is 2<sup>8</sup>. A light purple line with cross markers represents "Llama-1B" starting at approximately 0.39 when the number of completions is 2<sup>0</sup> and rising to approximately 0.77 when the number of completions is 2<sup>8</sup>.  A light green line with plus markers represents "Llama-1B + FT", starting at approximately 0.41 when the number of completions is 2<sup>0</sup> and rising to approximately 0.80 when the number of completions is 2<sup>8</sup>.
